UI.Subtitle: Connect your controller and move naturally.
UI.PairingHint: First use: pair the controller in Windows Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Add device → Bluetooth. This app does not perform system pairing.
UI.UsageSteps:
1. First use or a different PC: put the controller into pairing mode. Open Windows Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Add device → Bluetooth, select the controller, and finish pairing. Discovering a device does not mean it is paired.
2. Close controller apps on other PCs to avoid competing connections.
3. Press Trigger to wake the controller. By default, the app connects and enables the mouse automatically; you can also click Search and connect.
4. You can use the mouse without calibration. To calibrate, click Recalibrate or hold Oculus for 1 second, then keep the controller still.
UI.ControlsText:
Oculus press: center the cursor on the main display immediately
Oculus hold for 1 second: recalibrate without releasing; keep still
Trigger: left click; hold to drag
Back: right click
Touchpad: vertical / horizontal scrolling (whole notches)
Close or disconnect: stop control and release mouse buttons
UI.SettingsHint: Edit and save parameters on the Settings tab. Saving pauses mouse control; automatic calibration follows your setting. Device name and timeouts apply to subsequent connection attempts.
